chart.notes: Hand-built on a 127.0 BPM grid fitted to the drum stem (residual 8 ms). Each bar pattern was chosen from per-bar 16-step onset maps of the demucs stems (kick/clap/bass/vocal/synth) and every tap is snapped to the nearest real onset of its tagged stem within 45 ms. Chorus = halftime kick/snare groove only (one layer, same 2-bar pattern in every chorus); bridge = syncopated trap kick; dance break = four-on-the-floor 8th runs (8-tap and 10-tap runs).

judgment_window_ms.note: +-110 ms accept window around the geometric corner (early taps beyond -110 ms = turn too early => crash into wall; late beyond +110 ms = run off the edge). 8th-note runs here are 236 ms apart so windows never overlap.

grid.note: fitted to gapless-decoded kick/snare onsets (the demucs stems are 25.1 ms late and are re-aligned)

route.rule: forward-only: headings N/E/W, lateral staircase per 2-bar phrase alternating sides, corridor +-12 m

lyrics_chart.tap_fields: lyric = word, syl = syllable (debug only; engine ignores them)

sections.label: Intro · 病房走廊
sections.note: closed ward corridor, door-frame pairs give the beat scale; ceiling lights come on with the synth plucks

sections.label: Verse 1 · 治疗桌与五椅
sections.note: meander around the treatment table and five chairs; low walls tighten the space

sections.label: Verse 1b · 墙板外折
sections.note: ward wall panels fold outward one by one (pre-chorus feel), staircase widens

sections.label: Chorus 1 · 黑兔舞台
sections.note: fall 4 units onto the open stage level; the black low-poly bunny on its halftone base + five stage walls rise on the hook

sections.label: Verse 2 · 玻璃鞋
sections.note: glass slipper sculpture on a plinth, camera swings to side view

sections.label: Pre · 手机桥
sections.note: road becomes the long phone bridge B1 (black screen, cream body) climbing L1->L2 (+8)

sections.label: Chorus 2 · 屏幕块
sections.note: fall onto staggered right-angle road; phone-screen blocks lift off-road on the kicks

sections.label: Bridge · 书页墙与猫
sections.note: compressed angular S between book-page walls, road narrows to 1.8 and slopes up; black cat on a shelf

sections.label: Break · 书页合拢
sections.note: one-bar subtraction: pages close inward (stop outside clearance)

sections.label: Dance break · 舞台五墙
sections.note: five stage walls flip open on the four-on-the-floor; line passes over the start corridor on a bridge (+6)

sections.label: Final chorus · 兔耳发夹
sections.note: two unequal rectangular hairpins = bunny ears; skybridge B2

sections.label: Outro · 尾奏琴键
sections.note: long straight-ish meander to the halftone end plinth; three off-road piano keys; distant layers lower with the piano tail
